# Outpatient consultation rooms

!!! info "Definition"
    An outpatient consultation room is a clinical space where patients meet healthcare professionals for assessments, advice, diagnosis, follow-up care, and treatment planning without being admitted to hospital.

## Activity classification

Includes both first and follow-up face-to-face outpatient consultations.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Separately for first and follow-up consultations, calculate the effective consultation time by adding an allowance for time lost to appointments where patients do not attend (DNA).

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    \text{Effective consult time (minutes)}
    &= \text{Consult time (minutes)} \\
    &\quad + \left(
    \frac{\text{DNA rate}}{1-\text{DNA rate}}
    \times \text{DNA time (minutes)}
    \right)
    \end{aligned}
    $$

Multiply attended consultations by the effective consultation time, then convert minutes into hours.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Consultation hours}
    =
    \frac{\text{Attendances}
    \times
    \text{Effective consult time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Divide total consultation hours by the service's annual operating hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Required consultation rooms}
    =
    \frac{\text{Consultation hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First attendance | Consultation time | Pathway |
| First attendance | Did not attend rate | Pathway |
| First attendance | Did not attend time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |
| Follow-up attendance | Consultation time | Pathway |
| Follow-up attendance | Did not attend rate | Pathway |
| Follow-up attendance | Did not attend time | Pathway |

## Notes

Consultation durations are represented using subgroup-level averages and may not reflect variation between specialties.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `FIRST_OP_CONSULT_ROOMS`
    * `FOLLOW_UP_OP_CONSULT_ROOMS`

    **Conversion archetype:** appointment-slot utilisation · `FRM_APPOINTMENT_UTIL`

    **Operational constraint:** available appointment time, adjusted for utilisation

    **Workload object:** `consultation_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | First attendance | (`CLASS_OP_ATTEND` AND `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE` AND `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST`) |
    | Follow-up attendance | (`CLASS_OP_ATTEND` AND `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE` AND `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_OP_ATTEND` | Outpatient activity within the Demand Model scope | atentype IN (1, 2, 21, 22) AND sex IN (1, 2) AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 90 |
    | `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE` | Face-to-face outpatient activity | attendance = 1 |
    | `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST` | Outpatient activity assigned to the first-attendance group | group = "first" |
    | `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP` | Outpatient activity assigned to the follow-up group | group = "followup" |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_OP_ATTEND`: Age bounds are inclusive.
    * `CLASS_OP_FACE_TO_FACE`: attendance is calculated as 1 - is_tele_appointment. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 1 or 2 gives attendance = 1.
    * `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FIRST`: Assigned when has_procedures is false or null and is_first is true. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 1 or 21 gives is_first = true. Includes face-to-face and virtual activity.
    * `CLASS_OP_GROUP_FOLLOW_UP`: Assigned when has_procedures is false or null and is_first is false. Within the outpatient scope, atentype 2 or 22 gives is_first = false. Includes face-to-face and virtual activity.

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | First attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FIRST_TIME` |
    | First attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FIRST_DNA_RATE` |
    | First attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FIRST_DNA_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OP_CONSULT_UTIL` |
    | All groups | `OP_CONSULT_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_HOURS` |
    | Follow-up attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FOLLOW_UP_TIME` |
    | Follow-up attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FOLLOW_UP_DNA_RATE` |
    | Follow-up attendance | `OP_CONSULT_FOLLOW_UP_DNA_TIME` |
